notes.hook: The concept of a massive city of galaxies flying apart hooks interest quickly.
notes.clarity: The logical chain from speed calculations to missing mass is simple and easy to follow.
notes.payoff: The historical twist that Zwicky was ignored for fifty years delivers a strong conclusion.
notes.visuals: All graphics and archival photos are crisp, accurate, and clearly readable.
notes.loop: The closing line about bound systems connects nicely back to the opening beat.

rounds.better_than_last: This Short delivers a stronger narrative arc with historical depth compared to recent episodes.
